NP Presspad 1.3.9 — Maintenance

Maintenance release — dependency updates only, no user-facing changes.

This release refreshes the libraries NP Presspad is built on, including the first release to ship the Electron 44 and Vitest 5 upgrades that landed on `main` after 1.3.8. Everything here is under the hood; the app looks and works exactly as before.

### Dependency updates

- **Electron** 43 → 44 — the application framework (Chromium + Node.js runtime).
- **Editor (TipTap)** 3.31.4 → 3.32.0 — the rich-text editing engine.
- **React / React DOM** 19.3.0 → 19.3.1.
- **Radix UI components** — dialogs, selects, popovers, checkboxes, switches, toasts and related UI primitives updated to their latest minor/patch releases.
- **Lucide icons** 1.55.0 → 1.59.0.
- **Auto-updater (electron-updater)** 6.8.9 → 6.8.10.
- **Markdown & sanitisation** — `marked` 18.1.0 → 18.1.1, `sanitize-html` 2.18.0 → 2.18.1.
- **Validation (zod)** 4.6.5 → 4.6.7.
- **Testing (Vitest)** 4 → 5 — development tooling only.
